scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*|npm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm or npm with the pnpm bridge" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in npm/*) PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile ;; esac'
scripts.build: PORT=${PORT:-8080} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} corepack pnpm run typecheck && PORT=${PORT:-8080} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.railway:build: NODE_ENV=production PORT=4173 BASE_PATH=/ corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/chapter-monitor run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
